-- Data Warehouse 315130843710.00000

DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20230113
SELECT  SUM(TotalRelationshipBalanceFull) TotalRelationshipBalanceFull 
FROM [DW].[FactTotalRelationshipBalance]
WHERE BusinessDateSK = @BusinessDate
GROUP BY BusinessDateSK


-- DW Expected -3654684.00000

DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20230113;

WITH Loans AS (SELECT SUM(TotalRelationshipExposureFull)  TotalRelationshipExposureFull FROM [DW].[FactLoansRelationshipExposure] WHERE BusinessDateSK = @BusinessDate
), 
Cards AS (SELECT SUM(RelationshipExposure) TotalRelationshipExposureFull FROM [DW].[FactCardsRelationshipExposure] WHERE BusinessDateSK = @BusinessDate)

SELECT SUM(TotalRelationshipExposureFull) TotalRelationshipExposureFull
FROM ( SELECT * FROM Loans UNION ALL
       SELECT * FROM Cards
        ) A
